facts.business: Rollatainers Limited is a company that previously had investments in packaging and machinery subsidiaries (RT Packaging Limited and Rollatainers-Toyo Machine Private Limited) which were sold during the year, and currently has related party transactions with its holding company WLD Investments Private Limited.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to net loss of Rs. 74.16 lakhs and accumulated losses of Rs. 12,435.07 lakhs eroding net worth; Provisional Attachment Order by Directorate of Enforcement against promoter shares and bank accounts; Sale of material subsidiary RT Packaging Limited and joint venture Rollatainers-Toyo Machine Private Limited; Dormant bank accounts pending reconciliation; Trade payables, receivables and loans subject to reconciliation and confirmation.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to accumulated losses and erosion of net worth
Provisional Attachment Order by Directorate of Enforcement on promoter shares and bank accounts
Ongoing tax litigations and contingent liabilities
Trade payables, receivables and loans subject to reconciliation and confirmation
facts.related_party_note: The company has approved related party transactions with holding company WLD Investments Private Limited for FY 2026-27 with maximum amounts of Rs. 100 crores each for: sale/purchase of goods/materials, loan/technical leasing, consultancy fees, office/property transactions, and profit sharing.
